description: This file is a reference implementation of JSON parsing and stringifying functions, creating a global JSON object with methods stringify and parse, including polyfills for Date.prototype.toJSON and other types.

methods.name: JSON.stringify
methods.description: Serializes a JavaScript value to a JSON string with optional replacer and space parameters.

methods.name: JSON.parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JavaScript object or array with an optional reviver function.
